page.overview:
Who is Demodus Blix?

is a gnome illusionist and a graduate of the Penteveral of Dol-Makjar. As an NPC in Campaign Four, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Demodus is a young and handsome gnome with dark brown skin and ice-cream-swirled "fwoompy" hair. He has a curious condition that makes his irises supernaturally translucent, in a way that makes them look the color of whatever is behind his head. He wears a Penteveral vest holding school spirit badges, and a dark blue chest binder emblazoned with wizard stars.

He is beloved by many, and considered to be funny, hard-working, and enthusiastic. He is somewhat naïve, and grateful to a fault, to the point of trying to buy drinks for people who had given him money as a thanks, using that same money. He tries to show his own independence so that people that helped him in the past can be proud of him. He always gives people the benefit of the doubt.

Demodus was dropped off by his parents at the Penteveral when he was only 12 years old. Despite his age and lack of financial support from his family, he fell in love with the boarding school and wanted to eventually become a professor there. In the following decade he learned magic and became known as an illusion savant, a brilliant student with high school spirit; he was involved in many activities and events, fundraising money for specific dares and magical acts he couldn't fund by himself otherwise. He had an additional source of income from busking and doing small illusion shows in the Ogrimok Marketplace, but he had to stop when it became illegal to use magic in such spaces.
